OpenTofu, the open-source fork of Terraform, reached its 1.7 release milestone and is now considered production-ready by a growing number of infrastructure teams. Its provider ecosystem has matured rapidly, with all major cloud providers publishing compatible plugins. The project's state encryption feature, absent from Terraform, has been a key differentiator for organisations with strict compliance requirements. Several large enterprises have completed migrations from Terraform to OpenTofu, citing licence concerns following HashiCorp's BSL switch as the primary driver.
